comparison.multi_page_policy: Compare every page; output page_comparisons for non-reference renderers.
comparison.classification_policy: A raster difference is a diagnostic signal only; it is not by itself evidence that harumi or a renderer is defective.

poppler.golden_policy: The Poppler render is a deterministic smoke contract for page count and raster output. Pixel goldens must be generated per pinned renderer/version; do not treat Poppler pixels as Pdfium, Chrome, or Acrobat parity.

pdfium.golden_policy: Run only when a pinned Pdfium runtime is available. Compare dimensions and pixels within the same Pdfium build.
